Food & stay

Stays near Pantai Carocok

To stay near Pantai Carocok, start with the property’s exact pin and beach route, then match rooms, parking and arrival time to your plans. An area name alone does not establish a comfortable walk.

Updated · 27 November 2026

Location

Near beach vs central Painan

Compare properties around Carocok or Kampung Jao with those in central Painan. A 2018 government report records guest accommodation in Kampung Jao, but an older listing does not confirm current operation. Request the actual pin and check the door-to-door route rather than straight-line distance.

  • Check the entrance road, steps and access with luggage or a stroller.
  • Confirm parking, private bathroom, cooling and child policies.
  • Ask about check-in limits, breakfast, cancellation and extra charges.

Verify

Check before booking

Use official booking platforms or recent reviews to verify status, price, and facilities. Do not rely on one outdated source.

Request written confirmation

Save the address, pin, host contact and booking details. Confirm essential facilities directly with the property before paying.

Tips

For families

Check child policy, parking, and beach distance when travelling with family.

Questions

Before you go

01Are there hotels at Pantai Carocok?+

Stays exist near the beach and in central Painan, but we list no names because status changes. Verify via official booking platforms.

02Better near beach or in town?+

Near beach gives quick access; central Painan is fuller. Match to your needs.

03How much to stay?+

Prices vary and change; compare via official platforms before booking.

04Safe for families?+

Check child policy and facilities via recent reviews.
